description.zh: 用一句话描述要找的文件、应用或系统设置：拆解概念、时间、类型、位置和大小，用本机 INT8 向量模型按意思重排；覆盖常见与冷门文件类型，支持显式扩展名和自定义行业类型。完全离线，不联网。
description.en: Describe the file or Windows setting you want; it parses concepts, time, type, place and size, then reranks with a local INT8 model. Common and rare types, explicit extensions, custom industry types and a built-in Windows settings catalog. Fully offline.

description.zh: 说一句你要找什么，不用记得文件名
description.en: Say what you are looking for; the name is not needed

hint.zh: 例如：去年报销的规定、上周的会议记录、桌面上的合同 PDF
hint.en: e.g. last year's expense rules, last week's meeting notes

ai.description: Find local files, installed apps or common Windows settings by a natural-language description (Chinese or English), e.g. "last year's travel expense rules" or "猫打针的记录". It understands common concepts, time ranges, file types, folders and sizes, searches WinShun's file and content indexes, then reranks the passages with a local embedding model on this PC. Returns files, folders, apps and settings with path, why they matched and a content snippet. It is read-only and never opens files; the user opens a result.

hint.zh: 用分号隔开，例如 %USERPROFILE%\Documents;D:\工作。留空搜索所有已索引位置
hint.en: Separated by semicolons, e.g. %USERPROFILE%\Documents;D:\Work. Empty: everywhere indexed

hint.zh: 用 Win顺 的文件内容索引；关掉就只按文件名找
hint.en: Uses WinShun's file content index; off means names only

title.zh: 在结果里显示内容片段

hint.zh: 副标题里给出最相关的一段文字，方便不打开就判断
hint.en: The most relevant passage in the subtitle, so you can judge without opening

hint.zh: 完全在本机运行；关掉只用概念和词面
hint.en: Entirely on this PC; off means concepts and words only

hint.zh: 自动：内存 ≥16GB 且放了 base 时用均衡，否则轻量。换档后下一条查询生效
hint.en: Auto: balanced when 16 GB+ RAM and the base model is present, otherwise light. Applies to the next query

title.zh: 自动（按内存和已放模型选）
轻量 · bge-small INT8 · 24 MB · 最快
均衡 · bge-base INT8 · 103 MB · 更准
title.en: Balanced · bge-base INT8 · 103 MB · more accurate

title.zh: 高质量 · bge-large INT8 · 需自备 327 MB
title.en: Quality · bge-large INT8 · bring your own 327 MB

hint.zh: 仅“自定义”档使用；相对插件目录，里面要有 model_quantized.onnx、vocab.txt 和 onnxruntime.dll
hint.en: Only for the Custom preset; relative to the plugin folder: model_quantized.onnx, vocab.txt and onnxruntime.dll

hint.zh: 1 到 8，默认 4；性能好的机器可以调高
hint.en: 1 to 8, default 4; higher on a fast machine

hint.zh: 64 到 384，默认 128；越大越准也越慢
hint.en: 64 to 384, default 128; more is more accurate and slower

hint.zh: 格式：词=扩展名;词=扩展名。例：点云=las,laz;标本=svs,ndpi;注塑=mold,stp。不认识的行业格式写在这里，或直接用 *.扩展名
hint.en: Format: word=ext;word=ext. e.g. pointcloud=las,laz; or just type *.ext
